name: Path aliases
goal: When working in projects, especially big ones, it is very handy to create path aliases. It gives more clarity as to where files are located and prevents "../../.." paths.

normalLearnings: I can create path aliases in React
result: At the import statements at the top of the page, I use the aliases "Pages" and "Components" to import the files. I created them in a webpack.config.js file. The usage can be seen below:<<image 4.png>>
validation: I ran the project and got no errors, warnings or other messages. When using the aliases in other use cases, like navigation urls, I got redirected successfully.
contribution: This allows me to faster develop the project. It also gives a much more clear structure.
